sources.title: Inkling - Thinking Machines Lab
sources.snippet: Inkling-Small is shown with a solid purple line, Inkling with the heavier cobalt line, and the comparison models with dashed lines. Evaluations without a reported model score are plotted at zero. Hover an evaluation to compare every model's score.

sources.title: lightseekorg/Inkling-Small-MXFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This checkpoint was produced by applying AMD Quark MXFP4 file-to-file quantization to the BF16 Inkling-Small checkpoint. Attention layers, shared experts, router weights, embeddings, normalization layers, multimodal components, MTP weights, and transformer layers 0-2 remain in BF16.

sources.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview TML Inkling-Small is a natively multimodal 276B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from Thinking Machines Lab. It activates 12B parameters per token and uses the same Inkling architecture and vLLM serving configuration as its larger 975B-parameter sibling, while substantially reducing the deployment footprint.
